name: Project wizard
author: Brett
description: The New project wizard: name and description, a linked repo (required: new or existing GitHub repo, VPS repo, or a server folder), starter code (a console-style React + TypeScript + Python app by default), framework and libraries (AXF by default, your own or an imported one), skin, the Claude account and models for its builds, and an optional first plan, typed or spoken. Optional steps start on the current project's values. It writes the project manifest, _claude/ files and a Claude.ai project kit, creates the project's workspace and switches into it. Every step works through the API, MCP, the CLI and voice (draft, then create).

items.title: New project choices
items.description: Every step of the New project wizard and its choices: starters, frameworks, libraries, skins, models and Claude accounts, with the current project's values (voice: 'what can a new project start from').

items.title: Current project's setup
items.description: The active project and the starter, framework, skin, Claude account and models a new project starts on (voice: 'what does a new project start with').

items.title: Start a new project from
items.description: What a new project starting from blank, a copy of the current project, or a saved boilerplate gets: the setup its optional steps start on, a name suggestion and what comes along (voice: 'start the new project from the Client site boilerplate'). Put the choice in the plan with draft-set {startFrom}.

startFrom.description: {kind: blank|current|boilerplate, id: the boilerplate id, carry: {items: structure|all|none, builds: bool}}

items.title: New project draft
items.description: The new project being set up step by step, and what still stops it (voice: 'how is the new project looking').

items.title: Set a new project step
items.description: Fill one or more wizard steps without the UI (voice: 'call the new project Garden', 'link it to a new GitHub repo', 'use the Windows skin', 'builds on Opus'). set merges fields: display, description, source {kind: new|github|vps|folder, repo, path}, homes {github {mode: new|existing|skip, owner, name}, vps {mode}}, starter {id: console-app|template|framework|none, template, boilerplate}, framework {mode: axf|own|import, libraries, privateLibraries, name, import {repo, path, boilerplate}}, skin {id}, claude {account, models {plan, build, review: opus|fable}}, firstPlan {text, builds, spoken}, startFrom {kind: blank|current|boilerplate, id, carry {items, builds}}, inherit {starter, framework, skin, accounts}, switchTo. reset true starts again.

items.title: Check a new project
items.description: Review a plan (or the draft with fromDraft true): the problems that stop it and the warnings. Changes nothing.

items.title: Create the new project
items.description: Make the project from a plan or the draft (fromDraft true): repo, starter code, manifest and _claude/ files, setup, Claude.ai kit, its own workspace, and switch into it (voice: 'create the new project'). Tell Brett first: it creates repositories and pushes.

fromDraft.description: use the draft built with draft-set

plan.description: a whole plan instead of the draft
